extraction_notes: The paper reports turnover frequencies per exposed, edge, corner, support-contact corner, non-contact corner, and concave-site corner Au atoms, but it does not report a TOF particle-size dependence of the form TOF ~ d^(-n); therefore size_dependence is empty. Activity rates reported here are the stabilized CO oxidation rates per gram of catalyst at 0 °C after 10–15 h on stream, as requested.
